verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a hosted search SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging or test mode that isolates testing from production data. Switching between applications in the CLI and running live A/B tests are adjacent capabilities, not an isolated sandbox. Quickstart sample data is onboarding material, not an environment-isolation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
